text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...! The time is finally upon us, 
Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day to test the results of my 
routine experiments!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? Listen well—we're going to 
record everything that happens today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's what I like to hear! Now you've got 
me excited too...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us see what kind of result all 
this hard work will bring...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why don't we go find out for ourselves!
